artifact: SPEC (_bmad-output/specs/spec-orca-observer/: SPEC.md, acceptance-tests.md, adapter-contract.md, owner-decisions-and-risks.md, release-gates.md, rendering-rules.md, snapshot-export-schema.md, stack.md, unverified-register.md, write-back-future-stage.md)
self_audit: Full-file path walk of all 10 SPEC files (ARCHITECTURE-SPINE.md excluded). Walked: argv/cursor values, paging loop exits (hasMore, nextCursor, empty page, cap, mid-traversal failure), parse required/optional/typed fields, sentinel collisions, identity and dedupe, cross-cycle ordering and timestamps, collector error classes, discovery, STALE/FAILED/backoff, first-cycle and no-last-good states, COUNTS/header tokens, width ranges, height, NO_COLOR, ASCII, key reader signals, selection, historical enum, change marks, retention and restart, snapshot envelope/status/versioning/ordering/write atomicity/multi-observer, export. Checked source lines: unverified-register.md:17 lists result.warnings[] and no namespace field; architecture-options.md:83-88 is the source of the snapshot status set. Owner decisions and listed open questions (SPEC.md:98-114) were not flagged as defects; width/height matrix gaps are noted only as MINOR pointers to SPEC.md:113.

findings.trigger_condition: Two or more rows arrive with dispatchId absent or blank in one cycle
findings.guard_snippet: if row.dispatchId is UNKNOWN or blank: key = ('no-id', cycle, page, index); flag 'identity unknown'; never dedupe
findings.potential_consequence: Distinct workers collapse into one row and are reported as duplicate rows ignored

findings.trigger_condition: Source namespace is needed for identity but no rule derives it; no verified namespace field exists
findings.guard_snippet: namespace = observer-derived tuple (resolved binary path, projection.host.id, runId), labelled observer-derived; define it once in adapter-contract
findings.potential_consequence: Identity, T39 and 'Runs never merge' rest on an undefined or invented key

findings.trigger_condition: Before the first successful poll, or first cycle FAILED with no last good snapshot
findings.guard_snippet: if last_good is None: counts='collected unknown / reported unknown'; ledger='no successful worker-list read yet'; as of='never'
findings.potential_consequence: Empty ledger and collected 0 read as an empty fleet

findings.trigger_condition: Page 1 succeeds, a later page fails, times out, overruns or has bad shape
findings.guard_snippet: on page k>1 failure: keep pages 1..k-1 as PARTIAL (page k failed: <reason>); define whether this counts as success for STALE
findings.potential_consequence: Fresh rows discarded, or mixed-cycle rows shown as one complete read

findings.trigger_condition: hasMore is true but nextCursor is absent, empty, or repeats the previous cursor
findings.guard_snippet: if hasMore and (not nextCursor or nextCursor in seen_cursors): stop; mark PARTIAL (cursor missing or not advancing, page k)
findings.potential_consequence: Traversal stops looking complete, or re-reads one page as fake duplicates

findings.trigger_condition: An opaque cursor legitimately starts with '-' (base64url alphabet includes '-')
findings.guard_snippet: pass cursor as '--cursor', value only after parser support for that form is recorded; else stop paging with PARTIAL (cursor rejected by observer)
findings.potential_consequence: Paging silently stops with no defined on-screen state

findings.trigger_condition: Cursor exceeds the byte bound or contains a NUL byte
findings.guard_snippet: if len(cursor.encode())>MAX or '0x00' in cursor: stop; PARTIAL (cursor over bound, page k)
findings.potential_consequence: Undefined outcome; NUL raises ValueError inside subprocess.run

findings.trigger_condition: Required key present but null or wrong type, e.g. hasMore='false', workers=null
findings.guard_snippet: require isinstance(workers, list) and isinstance(hasMore, bool) else FAILED (shape); treat JSON null as UNKNOWN; check total is non-negative int
findings.potential_consequence: String 'false' is truthy; paging loops or crashes instead of FAILED (shape)

findings.trigger_condition: Orca returns the literal value 'unknown' or 'UNKNOWN' (e.g. liveness.verdict)
findings.guard_snippet: render absent as 'unknown (absent in source)' and quote source values; snapshot: absent -> {'absent': true}, not a string
findings.potential_consequence: Source-reported unknown and missing field become indistinguishable; evidence label lost

findings.trigger_condition: Source sends an empty string for a present key
findings.guard_snippet: render '' as 'blank (in source)', distinct from absent; snapshot keeps '' with a present flag
findings.potential_consequence: A source-given blank is relabelled as not given

findings.trigger_condition: worker-list returns a non-empty result.warnings[] (verified field, no rendering rule)
findings.guard_snippet: if warnings: strip token 'source warnings: n (inspector)'; inspector lists sanitized warnings; snapshot carries source.warnings
findings.potential_consequence: Source-disclosed partial or degraded results silently dropped

findings.trigger_condition: Cycle is PARTIAL, mismatch, changed-during-read, NOT POLLED or binary not found
findings.guard_snippet: add optional collection{state: PARTIAL|COMPLETE|MISMATCH, collected, pagesRead, changedDuringRead, duplicatesIgnored} and row.reobserved/orderUnknown flags
findings.potential_consequence: Go screen reads a partial or stale fleet as OK and complete

findings.trigger_condition: Observer restarts (cycle resets to 1) or two observers run at once
findings.guard_snippet: add producer.instanceId (random per process) and producer.startedAt; consumers order by (instanceId, cycle), never cycle alone
findings.potential_consequence: Consumer discards fresh snapshots as older or interleaves two producers

findings.trigger_condition: Snapshot write path, atomicity, concurrent writers and FAILED-cycle writes are unspecified
findings.guard_snippet: write to tmp in same dir, fsync, os.replace(path); per-instance file name; write on FAILED cycle with status ERROR and last-good rows
findings.potential_consequence: Reader sees a torn file or another observer's overwrite

findings.trigger_condition: Integer schemaVersion has no minor; consumer meets an additive optional field
findings.guard_snippet: schemaVersion '1.0' (major.minor); rule: consumers MUST ignore unknown fields within a known major
findings.potential_consequence: Strict decoder rejects the first additive change, breaking additive-only

findings.trigger_condition: page.total, counts or a counts member is absent upstream
findings.guard_snippet: schema declares union types (int | 'UNKNOWN', map | 'UNKNOWN') per field; schema test covers each
findings.potential_consequence: Typed Go consumer fails decoding when a number becomes a string

findings.trigger_condition: Both timestamps UNKNOWN, or equal timestamps with equal dispatchId across namespaces
findings.guard_snippet: UNKNOWN timestamps sort last; final tie-break (namespace, dispatchId)
findings.potential_consequence: Snapshot row order is non-deterministic between identical inputs

findings.trigger_condition: Local '/' filter, 'h' toggle or selection active when the snapshot is written
findings.guard_snippet: snapshot serializes the unfiltered model including hidden historical rows; never local filter or selection state
findings.potential_consequence: Consumer receives a filtered subset presented as the whole fleet

findings.trigger_condition: Duplicates within one cycle carry different field values
findings.guard_snippet: within a cycle keep the copy with the newer timestamp; if equal or absent keep first and flag 'conflicting duplicates'
findings.potential_consequence: An older copy may win inside a cycle, undercutting T22

findings.trigger_condition: Timestamp not parseable as ISO-8601, equal across cycles, or only one cycle has observedAt
findings.guard_snippet: parse failure -> treat as absent and flag 'time unparseable'; equal -> newer cycle wins; compare like field with like field only
findings.potential_consequence: Parse exception fails every cycle, or mixed-field comparison picks wrong row

findings.trigger_condition: Orca timestamp lies in the future relative to the observer wall clock
findings.guard_snippet: if age < 0: render 'age unknown (clock skew)', never a negative or zero age
findings.potential_consequence: Negative or 0s evidence age renders as fresh

findings.trigger_condition: Source both FAILED last cycle and past the 45 s STALE threshold
findings.guard_snippet: cell = 'STALE <age since success>; last FAILED (<reason>)' with a fixed precedence
findings.potential_consequence: Implementations differ; 'FAILED (exit 2) 1m' can hide staleness

findings.trigger_condition: Validation probe fails though binary exists; binary installed later; spawn raises OSError
findings.guard_snippet: distinguish 'not found' vs 'validation failed'; retry discovery on backoff; catch OSError as FAILED (spawn error)
findings.potential_consequence: Misleading 'binary not found', permanent NOT AVAILABLE, or collector thread dies

findings.trigger_condition: Both orca-ide and orca validate and point at different Orca instances
findings.guard_snippet: show resolved binary path and version in header/inspector; include it in source.namespace
findings.potential_consequence: Observer silently watches a different Orca than the user expects

findings.trigger_condition: Header must show 'read k of N Runs' but R1 has no verified source for N
findings.guard_snippet: N = distinct runId seen this session, labelled 'N seen, total unknown'; or omit until a Run list source is verified
findings.potential_consequence: Header prints an invented denominator implying coverage

findings.trigger_condition: Not-reobserved worker rows accumulate over a long session with dispatch churn
findings.guard_snippet: exclude not-reobserved rows from 'collected n'; bound them (e.g. 1,000) with 'k not-reobserved rows dropped from view'
findings.potential_consequence: Collected count overstated; unbounded memory growth

findings.trigger_condition: terminalState absent or a value other than released/retained
findings.guard_snippet: only released/retained are historical; absent or other values shown, labelled raw, never counted active or hidden
findings.potential_consequence: Unknown-state rows hidden or counted active

findings.trigger_condition: Selected row is hidden by the local filter or turns historical while hidden
findings.guard_snippet: keep cursor on identity with 'selected <id> hidden by filter/historical'; never jump
findings.potential_consequence: Cursor jumps to another worker against the identity rule

findings.trigger_condition: Width far below 80 where one never-truncated token exceeds the line
findings.guard_snippet: below 80: print 'terminal too narrow (min 80)' and denominators one token per line, hard-wrapping by cells
findings.potential_consequence: Lines overflow width or priority tokens get cut

findings.trigger_condition: R1 ledger (A) at widths 81-115, 117-159 or above 160
findings.guard_snippet: state ranges: >=160 full row, 116-159 line form, 80-115 narrow form (pending A's width matrix)
findings.potential_consequence: Most real terminal widths have no defined R1 layout

findings.trigger_condition: Terminal resized mid-session (SIGWINCH)
findings.guard_snippet: re-read size each frame; re-apply width and height rules on resize
findings.potential_consequence: Stale geometry overflows or wrongly shows too-narrow

findings.trigger_condition: NO_COLOR set to a value other than 1 or yes (e.g. true)
findings.guard_snippet: no_color = bool(os.environ.get('NO_COLOR')); T26 adds a third arbitrary value
findings.potential_consequence: Colour emitted despite NO_COLOR, contrary to no-color.org

findings.trigger_condition: Non-UTF-8 locale without --ascii, or --ascii with CJK/emoji source text
findings.guard_snippet: auto-select ASCII when stdout encoding is not UTF-8; in ASCII mode escape non-encodable chars as '?' or U+XXXX
findings.potential_consequence: Encode errors or mojibake on legacy terminals

findings.trigger_condition: Raw mode disables ISIG; Ctrl-Z, SIGHUP or a collector exception occurs
findings.guard_snippet: use cbreak (ISIG kept) or map 0x03 to quit; restore on SIGTSTP/SIGHUP and re-enter on SIGCONT
findings.potential_consequence: Ctrl-C ignored or terminal left in raw mode

findings.trigger_condition: Bare Esc versus the ESC prefix of arrow-key sequences, split across reads
findings.guard_snippet: after ESC, select() 50 ms for '[' or 'O'; otherwise treat as Esc
findings.potential_consequence: Arrow keys trigger Esc, or Esc hangs waiting

findings.trigger_condition: Interactive mode started with stdin or stdout not a TTY
findings.guard_snippet: if not sys.stdin.isatty() or not sys.stdout.isatty(): exit 2 'interactive needs a TTY; use --once'
findings.potential_consequence: termios raises at start-up or escape codes written into a pipe

findings.trigger_condition: Source text contains DEL 0x7F or U+2028/U+2029 line separators
findings.guard_snippet: also strip 0x7F and Zl/Zp; T29 injection fixture includes them
findings.potential_consequence: Layout broken by hidden line breaks in list cells

findings.trigger_condition: A call's stdout exceeds the 8 MiB cap
findings.guard_snippet: stop reading at cap, kill and reap, mark FAILED (output over 8 MiB); never parse the truncated buffer
findings.potential_consequence: Undefined state; truncated JSON parsed or misreported

findings.trigger_condition: stdout contains bytes that are not valid UTF-8
findings.guard_snippet: decode strict; on error FAILED (invalid UTF-8) with byte offset in inspector
findings.potential_consequence: Uncaught decode error or silently replaced characters

findings.trigger_condition: 'e' pressed: target path exists, is unwritable, or a filter is active
findings.guard_snippet: write to a new timestamped file; show path or 'export failed: <reason>'; export header records active filter and h state
findings.potential_consequence: Earlier export overwritten or filtered export read as full

findings.trigger_condition: R2 observer restarts; in-memory retained questions are lost
findings.guard_snippet: on start, question panel shows 'retention reset at HH:MM; earlier questions not retained'; count reads unknown until reobserved
findings.potential_consequence: Open question count drops on restart, against 'questions stay until resolution'

findings.trigger_condition: Retention exceeds 1,000; 'oldest first' may mean evicting the oldest question
findings.guard_snippet: state eviction order explicitly; prefer evicting newest-duplicate-free overflow and keep oldest open items
findings.potential_consequence: Oldest open question, the most urgent, vanishes from the list

findings.trigger_condition: Backoff active: reset rule and cycle budget under backoff undefined
findings.guard_snippet: reset to 15 s on first success; per-call timeout and budget stay at 15 s during backoff
findings.potential_consequence: A hung call may run up to 60 s; recovery timing inconsistent

findings.trigger_condition: result.counts absent, or contains a state key beyond the four named
findings.guard_snippet: absent -> 'source counts unknown'; extra keys -> 'k other states (inspector)'
findings.potential_consequence: Extra source states silently dropped from the screen

findings.trigger_condition: result.scope.source is a value other than flag, bound or all
findings.guard_snippet: render raw value plus 'scope meaning unknown'
findings.potential_consequence: Unknown scope silently treated as fleet-wide

findings.trigger_condition: Last good poll before midnight, or ages over an hour
findings.guard_snippet: 'as of' includes date when not today; ages format as 1h2m / 1d3h
findings.potential_consequence: Yesterday's data reads as today's

findings.trigger_condition: Field goes value to unknown, or a not-reobserved row reappears after a mark
findings.guard_snippet: count value->unknown as a change; reappearance shows '* reobserved'
findings.potential_consequence: Lost evidence never surfaces as a change

findings.trigger_condition: PARTIAL or mismatch when page.total is absent
findings.guard_snippet: PARTIAL: collected n of reported unknown; mismatch check skipped and stated
findings.potential_consequence: Forms built on T are unpinned when T is unknown

findings.trigger_condition: New dispatches insert during paging, shifting rows between pages
findings.guard_snippet: 'collected n' counts unique identities after dedupe; note 'rows shifted during read' when duplicates span pages
findings.potential_consequence: Real churn shown as duplicates; skipped rows undisclosed

findings.trigger_condition: First observation in the process is PARTIAL or FAILED
findings.guard_snippet: baseline = first successful cycle; label 'baseline partial (pages 1..k)'
findings.potential_consequence: Later rows starred as added though only previously unread
